proof: SPECIAL SERVICES DEPARTMENT, PDF page 34 of the FY2013 annual town report (printed page 31), headed `FY13 (data taken from 2012-2013 school year)`. NO TEXT LAYER; read off the page's own 400 dpi bitmap. THE FIGURES ARE PRINTED AS PROSE AND IN WORDS, NOT IN A TABLE, which is why fifteen years of this series went unread (CLAUDE.md, the standing questions): `There are two hundred and ninety-two students with disabilities... This represents 18.4% of our total student population of 1, 587 students... twenty-two students received services outside the district during the 2012/2013 school year. Of the twenty-two students, seventeen are in day placements and five are in residential placements... five are serviced in Collaboratives... Ninety-three students identified with a disability receive accommodations via 504 plans`. THE CHECK: the passage states an identity about itself and it closes -- 17 day + 5 residential = 22 out of district. That is the only arithmetic on the page. WHAT IT DOES NOT ESTABLISH. These are CHILDREN, not dollars, and nothing here attaches a cost or a fund to any placement (CLAUDE.md rule 11). The five Collaborative placements are described as part of the day placements and the remainder is given only as `the rest`, so the private-day count is NOT printed and is not recorded. The page does not say on what date the counts were taken; the same series read from other years is sourced to SIMS Report 7 at 1 March, and that is not stated here.
